get.description: Retrieves deprecated threat feed items from Socket.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the threat in the package artifact was first discovered

description.description: Detailed description of the underlying threat

id.description: Unique identifier of the threat feed entry

locationHtmlUrl.description: URL to the threat details page on Socket

needsHumanReview.description: Whether the threat still is in need of human review by the threat research team

packageHtmlUrl.description: URL to the affected package page on Socket

publishedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the package artifact was published to the respective registry

purl.description: Package URL (PURL) of the affected package artifact

removedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the package artifact was removed from the respective registry, or null if the package is still available on the registry

threatInstanceId.description: Unique threat instance identifier across artifacts

threatType.description: Threat classification. Possible values: `malware` (known malware), `possible_malware` (AI-detected potential malware), `vulnerability` (potential vulnerability), `typosquat` (human-reviewed typosquat), `possible_typosquat` (AI-detected potential typosquat), `anomaly` (anomalous behavior), `telemetry` (telemetry), `obfuscated` (obfuscated code), `dual_use` (dual-use tool), `troll` (protestware or joke package), `unreviewed` (not yet reviewed), `false_positive` (confirmed false positive).

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the threat record for the package artifact was last updated (e.g., classification changed, package removed from registry, etc.)
